runtimeAvailability: Introduced incrementally by P1-P6; these declarations are not existing API endpoints

wireTypes.sequenceNumber: string matching ^[0-9]{4}$; never a JSON number
wireTypes.workspaceRevision: integer in [0, 9007199254740991]; database bigint; overflow fails rather than wraps
wireTypes.md5: 32 lower-case hexadecimal characters; eCTD compatibility, not immutable content identity
wireTypes.relativePath: case-preserved slash-separated logical path without a leading slash, query, fragment or parent segment
wireTypes.timestamp: UTC ISO 8601 string; captured values are preserved in immutable manifests

nodeIdentity.comparison: Ordinal equality of parsed XML attribute values, including case and whitespace; no heuristic trim, transliteration or case folding
nodeIdentity.missingValue: Missing and present values have distinct encodings; ambiguous missing identity metadata requires repair
nodeIdentity.nonRepeatableUniqueness: One instance per application, parent and definition; a separate root uniqueness constraint covers NULL parents
nodeIdentity.ambiguousImport: Preserve separate instance IDs and source locations; report ambiguity instead of merging equal sibling contexts
nodeIdentity.extensionIdentity: Stable explicit instance ID; title is sequence metadata and cannot be its database key
nodeIdentity.identityChange: Create a new logical instance or use an explicit reviewed mapping; never rewrite historical business identity

historyBaseline.completeWhen: Every required historical XML address resolves in explicitly selected, compatible and verified source versions
historyBaseline.submissionInference: None; validation or finalization never implies submission or regulatory acceptance

concurrency.commit: Compare-and-increment in the same database transaction as the complete logical mutation; one increment per atomic execution unit
concurrency.noChange: Rejected or completely compensated mutations do not increment; a surviving reconciled change increments and invalidates prior validation
concurrency.externalChange: Input digest checks remain necessary: external file changes need not increment the database revision
concurrency.applicationDefaults: List affected editable drafts and revise each affected draft; never change a historical snapshot

idempotency.payload: Digest of the complete normalized request, selected inputs and their immutable versions
idempotency.sameKeySamePayload: Return the same durable operation or result, including after a lost response

transitions.guard: Expected revision, complete captured input and unique durable job
Compensation or recoverable quarantine recorded; fixed snapshots are never rolled back
Candidate bytes verified, necessary checks completed and snapshot transaction committed
New draft ID and next workspace revision; preserve source snapshot and regulatory sequence number
Job ownership, candidate manifest and file digests match; database uniqueness enforced
Return existing snapshot; cleanup and lost responses cannot undo committed content

asyncResponse.cancellation: A request flag, not a terminal outcome
